title: Implement ASUS scraper
description:
Create src/psp_etl/scrape/asus.py implementing VendorScraper for ASUS.
- Enumerate AM4/AM5 boards from ASUS product pages
- Parse BIOS download links from dlcdnets.asus.com
- Download ZIPs, extract .CAP files
- Implement CAP header stripping (0x800-byte ASUS capsule header)
- Depends on: scraper base class, extract.py
